strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
Aya, are all the summoned pilots here?
Then we're just waiting on Major Kai.
(The members are pilots of machines with special@man-machine interfaces... the <T-LINK System>,@the <Sympathia>, or the Cytron System.)
(Though I'm the exception...@Probably because I operate the SRX.)
Ryusei, have you heard what this is about?
Hey, Touya.@Why didn't they call Calvina?
Probably because of the Cytron System...@We can link with it, so I think that's@why we were included in this group.
Then let's begin. The Steel Dragons' next mission is@exterminating the <Lamaris> in Jakarta. During it,@I want the members here to carry out a certain task.
Dr. Kenzou Kobayashi in Izu@will explain the details.
A key member of the <SRX Project> who developed@the SRX and the R Series. He's the one@who created the <T-LINK System>.
And he's Captain Aya and Mai's father.
I'm Kenzou Kobayashi of the SRX Lab. The Lamaris that@have appeared everywhere are a serious threat, because@they keep reappearing even after being driven off.
According to our research so far,@most have appeared in densely populated areas.@It's only a hypothesis, but as long as people...
To be precise, I believe they'll keep appearing@as long as human thoughts exist.
You mean they feed on people's thoughts@and multiply?
But the Lamaris have been appearing@even in areas that were fully evacuated...
Is there something besides human thoughts@that can fuel their activity?
Most likely, it's the miscellaneous thoughts that@linger in places like busy districts... so-called@residual thoughts.
Or perhaps energy released by inhuman beings,@like the <Einst> or <Yokijin> of the past,@could also be nourishment for them.
As you know, in several areas where the@Steel Dragons wiped out the Lamaris,@they have not been seen reappearing, but...
they share the fact that they fused into Kaana types.@That may be a countermeasure in response@to strong thoughts.
And when struck by even more intense thoughts,@they can't absorb or otherwise process them,@and are completely annihilated...
So I'd like you, whom I've selected, to form a team@and test this hypothesis.
Also, as some of you may have noticed, most of you@use man-machine interfaces that link with your brains@in some way...
In other words, you are people who can convert@your thoughts into another kind of power@and release them.
So if we focus our thoughts and hit the Lamaris@with them, they turn into Kaana types...
That would explain why the Lamaris Kaana@only appear where we've been.
Because other units don't have machines with@the T-LINK System or the Sympathia?
Right. And it's now even more likely@the Fury's machines carry the Cytron System,@or something like it.
(And the hypothesis about the builders of the@Fabula Foresse and the roots of the Sympathia@gains credibility too...)
I understand the intent.@I just don't want to push her too hard.
It's okay, big brother.@Lately, whenever I use the Sympathia,@I feel like I can sense Chris.
She's gone far, far away, but it feels like she's@by my side, protecting me.@So I don't think anything bad will happen.
In the next operation, you'll be designated@Alpha Team. The leader is Aya.
Major Kai, I have a question.
There are T-LINK System users besides us.@What about them?
I'll answer that.@They'll be standing by in the rear@in case of an emergency.
(Like getting possessed by a Lamaris Kaana?)
If there are no other questions... The Hiryu Custom@will stay at Taoyuan Base while it repairs its space@transfer device, so only the Hagane will head out.
Space transfer will be executed at 1400.@We'll reach the Lamaris gathering point 60 seconds@after transfer. That is all.
Everyone, board your units in 10 minutes and stand by.@Got it?
I don't know about the others, but even if I'm told@to hit the Lamaris with strong thoughts,@I don't know how to actually do that...
I figured. Truth is, me neither.
I'm not a <Telekinetic>.@The Sympathia reacts to my thoughts, but it's not@a device that does things with telekinesis.
I'd guess the Cytron System is the same.
Then picture some kind of object in your head@and throw it at the Lamaris. That's what I plan to do.
If it's chocolate or cookies, I could probably do it...
What Josh said just now is right.
I picture a sword of light and throw it at the enemy.@The R-1's finishing move, the T-Link Sword...@that's exactly it.
Then you think up some spell-like words and shout the@attack name. Will it to break, become the blade--T-Link@Sword! Like that. That part's important.
Oh, that might actually be easy to get.
(Is that how it works...? I'm not confident.)
Don't feel pressured.@Thinking we can do it, we can pull it off...@that's one way of picturing it, too.
It did... in the final battle against the <Ruina>.
It may be cold comfort, but you've got us around you.
Yeah. Feel free to lean on us.
...Hearing you say that makes me feel a little better.
Good.@Let's both do our best, Touya Shiun.
Captain, we've reached the Lamaris gathering point.
All stop, both sides. <TD Hovering> at current@position and altitude.
The Lamaris swarm is getting even more active!
Roger. Launch in order, starting with Alpha Team.
Spiria 3 to all Alpha Team units.@Let's begin.
Rim.@If you feel anything strange, cut off@the <Sympathia> right away.
Touya, let's do it too.@Like Lieutenant Ryusei said, let's picture it.
Touya, think you can pull it off?
Honestly, I'm not confident. How about you, Tenia?
You just close your eyes and picture something, right?@It's easy.
Touya, let's do it too. Let's concentrate.
Touya, throw a sword of light.@Just trust me and give it a try.
(It's the same as That Time... when I first@activated the Sympathia in front of Granteed.)
The Lamaris swarm is fusing!@A Kaana type has appeared!
Yeah. Touya's power, or Granteed's performance...@or maybe both.
We were hitting it with our thoughts too, but@he's the one who gave it the last push.@I'd say he's got a knack for it.
The Kaana type is on the move!@It's approaching the ship!
So it is after Alpha Team?
Roger.@All units, commence attack! Wipe out@the Lamaris in the combat area!
No... It's not that. Everyone, be on guard.
Radar contact!@Unknown approaching fast! Straight from two o'clock!@Just one! Entering Range 3 shortly!
Identification complete! It's the Ares Geist!
(I'd seen it in recorded footage, but...@has its Jetzt transformation progressed further...?)
...Couldn't pass on in peace, eh? Same as me.
So it has fallen to the dark path and become a demon.
What we'd call a bounty head in our world?@Or are things like that all over the place here?
Nah, that one's actually super rare.
No... That doesn't seem to be the case.
New Lamaris appearing around the Ares Geist!
So the Ares Geist summoned the Lamaris?
No. If our thoughts are what trigger the Kaana types@to appear, then something similar to that@may have happened.
Then something inside the Ares Geist@is emitting thoughts...?
...It shouldn't be the <AI1> or Erde Mitte.
It seems to be heading this way.@You'd best be careful.@Especially you, Arieil.
The Ares Geist's presence is@stimulating the Lamaris' activity...?!
If we don't do something about the Ares Geist fast,@we could be in trouble.
Are they going to keep coming out forever...?!
The Ares Geist is leaving the combat area!
There are still Lamaris in the combat area.@Wiping them out is our top priority.
No. We'll stay in the current combat area and confirm@whether the Lamaris have been completely eliminated.
Remaining enemies wiped out! No enemies in the area!
This ship will hold TD Hovering at its position.@All units, maintain strict all-around watch.
(Those movements... Is the Ares Geist@coming after me?)
(I have no proof... But to find out@whether this hunch is right, for now...!)
(It either won't answer or can't answer...@I can't tell which.)
(If the Ares Geist is drawing in the Lamaris too...@could the reverse also be possible?)
(If he really did come back from inside the Cross Gate@after that battle ended... If such a thing@is possible...)
Whatever you are, if you stand@in the way of Josh and me,@I will show no mercy.
I can't predict how that thing will come at us...!
Careful, Touya! That thing's not normal!
I can see that! But we've got no choice!
Touya,@I can't predict how that thing will attack...!
(Where was it and what was it doing between running@into us in space and showing up here...?!)
(The Ares Geist's goal...@Could it be Lieutenant Arieil?)
This is our second time fighting it.@I'd like to get some kind of clue, but...
(Just what is the connection between@the Ares Geist and the Lamaris...?!)
I don't know what it's after, but unless we deal with it,@we can't liberate Jakarta!
That form...@A ghost fallen to the dark path, I'd say.@Beyond saving.
It's just like the Einst... No, the Jetzt.@The ultimate counterfeit, then.
...After the way it ended in that final battle,@I guess it can't be helped that it@came wandering back...
Always return alive... The iron rule of the Cry Wolves,@kept not by Captain Albero, who was absorbed,@but by you...!
(Did it survive because it was the one absorbed,@not the one doing the absorbing...?)
Just like Aya's old man guessed,@the <Lamaris> do react to our thoughts.
Yes. And when they're hit with thoughts too strong@to absorb, they vanish...@I hope they stop reappearing like before.
We'll need to stay in Jakarta for a while@to confirm that, but it seems@quite likely.
But does this mean we'll have to keep relying@on <Telekinetic> pilots to defeat the Lamaris?
No, I don't think that's the case.
Everyone has thoughts.@It's true a telekinetic's are special, strong enough@to be applied to weapons, but...
Telekinetics aren't the only thing the Lamaris fear.
It was the same when we fought <Perfectio>, the "King@of Ruin." What pushed it back beyond the <Cross Gate>@was the power of everyone's feelings there.
(Could that be...@what Josh was talking about earlier?)
But... the Ares Geist barging in@while we're fighting the Lamaris?@Where's that thing been all this time?
Nobody knew where it was since@we ran into it in space, right?
It came after us, just like last time.@It seemed to be targeting Lieutenant Arieil,@but to think it'd stir up the Lamaris...
But they were targeting@the Ares Geist too.
So at the very least, they're not allies.
If the Lamaris react to human thoughts,@couldn't the same be said@of the Ares Geist?
Alchemie, what do you think? What's inside it?
I can't tell clearly... It's all hazy.
You mean you can't see it?
Yes... It felt like something was rejecting me.
Rejecting, huh?@Then why'd it suddenly pull out, I wonder?
It's an ordinary answer, but wasn't it@because our attacks damaged it?
Or perhaps its operating time is limited,@it might be so.
(I don't think so...@Was it me that rejected it? Or..........)
